# SurveySparrow Launches SparrowCRM - the AI-Native Agentic CRM for Revenue Teams

Thursday, 03 September 2026 10:00 AM

Topic:

#### Product Announcements

_**SurveySparrow launches**_ [_**SparrowCRM**_](https://www.sparrowcrm.com/) _**an AI-native, agentic CRM that runs the entire sales process, connecting context from every deal and driving the right actions throughout the sales pipeline.**_

**CALIFORNIA CITY, CA / [ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / September 3, 2026 /** SurveySparrow, trusted by over 10,000 businesses across 149 countries, has been steadily evolving into a multi-product company. The company introduced ThriveSparrow, an employee experience platform, two years ago, followed by SparrowDesk, its AI-first customer support platform, in 2025. Now, SurveySparrow expands into sales and revenue with SparrowCRM, an AI-native agentic CRM built for revenue teams.

With SparrowCRM, SurveySparrow brings its multi-product approach to the sales stack, offering an AI-native alternative in a category long defined by legacy systems trying to build AI on top of outdated technology.

**SparrowCRM: Reimagining CRM for the AI Era**

The CRM market is now one of enterprise software's largest categories, worth around $80 billion in 2025 and projected to nearly double to roughly $160 billion by the early 2030s. Yet the core problem hasn't moved. Reps still spend only about 29% of their week actually selling, with the remaining 71% going to admin, data entry, and prep, a number that's barely improved despite years of new tooling.

SparrowCRM was built around a simple belief: reps should be able to focus on selling while the system keeps the work moving. Its agentic AI handles recording and follow-through and lets teams set up agents that carry out routine work on their own and keep every step of the sales process advancing.

"Sales teams are constantly switching between deals, conversations, follow-ups, and tasks, while their CRM only sees pieces of that picture," said **Shihab Muhammed, founder and CEO of SurveySparrow.**

"With SparrowCRM, we wanted to change that. The system understands the context across the pipeline, knows what needs to happen next, and can take action across the sales process. It gives reps an AI system that works alongside them, rather than another system they have to keep updated."

**Engineering a New Kind of CRM**

SparrowCRM was built from the ground up around the idea that AI should be part of the CRM's core architecture, not another layer added on top. The platform brings together sales data, conversations, activity, and pipeline context so AI can understand what is happening across multiple deals and take action within the workflow.

**Key capabilities include:**

- [**Deal Intelligence and Signals -** Show](https://pr.report/pug9) where opportunities stand, spot risks, and flag which deals need attention.

- **AI Agents -** Handle follow-ups, research, record updates, and CRM hygiene, keeping information current without manual upkeep.

- **Conversation Intelligence -** Turn calls and emails into summaries, action items, and deal context for every conversation.

- [**Agentic Workflows**](https://pr.report/puga) \- Let teams build agents that automate recurring sales work, from lead qualification and nurturing to routing and follow-through.

- [**Reporting and Pipeline Intelligence**](https://pr.report/pugb) \- Bring performance, trends, and deal health into one place for better sales decisions.


"An agentic CRM needs more than an AI layer. It needs an architecture that can bring together data, conversations, and activity in real time," said _**Balaji CM, Chief Technology Officer at SurveySparrow.**_

"We built SparrowCRM around that foundation so AI can operate directly within the sales workflow."

At the product level, SparrowCRM was designed around a different question: how much of the work around selling can the CRM take off the rep?

"Instead of adding more steps for sales teams, we focused on removing them," said _**Ganesh Ravi Shankar, Business Unit Head at SparrowCRM.**_

"We believe the CRM should be a live part of the business, understanding what is happening, surfacing what matters, and helping teams act on it. SparrowCRM is built to make the CRM more active and assistive, rather than another system teams simply update."

Together, these capabilities shift the CRM from a system reps have to maintain into one that actively participates in the sales process.

Early teams are already running pipelines on SparrowCRM. Reps are spending less time updating records, while managers are getting earlier visibility into deals that need attention. One early user summed up the daily briefing simply: "This is very good. Just the reminder, the to-do list for the day."

SparrowCRM meets enterprise data protection, security, and privacy standards and connects with the tools sales teams already use. It is available worldwide today with a 14-day free trial and access to the full platform. Learn how SparrowCRM works and deals with AI at [www.sparrowcrm.com](https://pr.report/pugc).

**About SurveySparrow**

SurveySparrow, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, United States, is an experience management platform that helps organisations collect feedback, understand customer and employee experiences, and turn insights into action. Trusted by over 10,000 businesses across 149 countries, SurveySparrow has powered 10M+ CX surveys, helping organisations create engaging feedback experiences and make better decisions with customer and employee insights.
